title: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the year
question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.

prediction.sql:
WITH whsle AS (
  SELECT c.category_name,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', w.whsle_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"
  FROM veg_whsle_df w
  JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', w.whsle_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
),
txn AS (
  SELECT c.category_name,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', t.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" AS selling_price
  FROM veg_txn_df t
  JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', t.txn_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
),
loss AS (
  SELECT c.category_name,
         l."loss_rate_%"
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
  JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
),
whsle_agg AS (
  SELECT category_name, year,
         AVG("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS avg_whsle,
         MAX("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS max_whsle,
         MIN("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS min_whsle,
         SUM("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_whsle
  FROM whsle
  GROUP BY category_name, year
),
txn_agg AS (
  SELECT category_name, year,
         SUM(selling_price) AS total_selling
  FROM txn
  GROUP BY category_name, year
),
loss_agg AS (
  SELECT category_name,
         AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
         SUM("loss_rate_%") AS total_loss
  FROM loss
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT wa.category_name,
       wa.year,
       ROUND(wa.avg_whsle, 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(wa.max_whsle, 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(wa.min_whsle, 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(wa.max_whsle - wa.min_whsle, 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
       ROUND(wa.total_whsle, 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ta.total_selling, 0), 2) AS total_selling_price,
       ROUND(la.avg_loss_rate, 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
       ROUND(la.total_loss, 2) AS total_loss,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ta.total_selling, 0) - wa.total_whsle, 2) AS profit
FROM whsle_agg wa
LEFT JOIN txn_agg ta ON wa.category_name = ta.category_name AND wa.year = ta.year
LEFT JOIN loss_agg la ON wa.category_name = la.category_name
ORDER BY wa.year, wa.category_name;

All output columns are rounded to 2 decimal places as requested.

  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', w.whsle_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
),
txn AS (
  SELECT c.category_name,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', t.txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
         t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" AS selling_price
  FROM veg_txn_df t
  JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', t.txn_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
),
loss AS (
  SELECT c.category_name,
         l."loss_rate_%"
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
  JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
),
whsle_agg AS (
  SELECT category_name, year,
         AVG("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS avg_whsle,
         MAX("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS max_whsle,
         MIN("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS min_whsle,
         SUM("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_whsle
  FROM whsle
  GROUP BY category_name, year
),
txn_agg AS (
  SELECT category_name, year,
         SUM(selling_price) AS total_selling
  FROM txn
  GROUP BY category_name, year
),
loss_agg AS (
  SELECT category_name,
         AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
         SUM("loss_rate_%") AS total_loss
  FROM loss
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT wa.category_name,
       wa.year,
       ROUND(wa.avg_whsle, 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(wa.max_whsle, 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(wa.min_whsle, 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(wa.max_whsle - wa.min_whsle, 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
       ROUND(wa.total_whsle, 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ta.total_selling, 0), 2) AS total_selling_price,
       ROUND(la.avg_loss_rate, 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
       ROUND(la.total_loss, 2) AS total_loss,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ta.total_selling, 0) - wa.total_whsle, 2) AS profit
FROM whsle_agg wa
LEFT JOIN txn_agg ta ON wa.category_name = ta.category_name AND wa.year = ta.year
LEFT JOIN loss_agg la ON wa.category_name = la.category_name
ORDER BY wa.year, wa.category_name;
